additions: Every real style-guide teaser-card instance sets both ctaTitle and ctaLinkDestination, so teaser-card.html's isConfigured guard is always true and it always renders as a linked <a class="cmp-teaser-card"> — the unlinked <div class="cmp-teaser-card"> branch (no CTA authored) has no live instance to exercise TC-INT-016/017/018 ('no hover state on non-CTA cards') against.
Added one instance with no ctaTitle/ctaLinkDestination set, so those tests have a real div.cmp-teaser-card to check instead of self-skipping.
